strings: m_c usually feels at least a little bit tired. Today is no exception.
m_c doesn't know how everyone else wakes up with so much energy.
m_c just wants to roll over and go back to bed, but {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} grumbling stomach tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} otherwise.
The only reason that m_c got up today was so that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates weren't disturbed by {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} snoring.
